informal_statement: If \(\beta\) is the unique admissible type-(B) angle of area \(v\), its perimeter is the sole element of the value set.
reason: CMVBallCase.lean:1098-1110: Lean assumes an admissible beta of area v and a universal implication identifying every other admissible angle of that area with beta. The author's uniqueness wording and conditional set equality preserve all these hypotheses.
